tracks.title: Dabke Fusion Theme
tracks.why: Most direct dabke dance cue: titled and tagged as dabke/fusion belly-dance instrumental. Short looping bed for the circle. Set as the default (first in the playlist).

tracks.title: Melodic Dabke Fusion Theme
tracks.why: Same series as #1, a slightly longer and more melodic dabke-fusion instrumental. Good second track in the playlist.

tracks.title: Festival of Eid Joy (2)
tracks.why: Festive Levantine/Middle Eastern instrumental with strings and percussion (oud/qanun/darbuka/mizmar tags). Explicitly tagged dabke. Energetic celebration length (~2:14).

tracks.title: Festival of Eid Joy (1)
tracks.why: Companion festive track to #3, also tagged dabke and Levantine. Longer bed (~3:59) for the square if a short loop feels tight.

tracks.title: Sam energetic Wedding music 2
